messages:
Aiden (Support): handing off urgent: multiple pilots showing 'activation stalled' after SSO succeeds. admins report 'pending' and can't invite users. seeing 502s on /onboard/complete.
Rosa (CSM): which accounts? any near-term renewals?
Aiden (Support): CareSense (pilot, 75 seats, renewal 2026-09), LumenRx (trial, 9 seats, trial ends in 6d), WaveHealth (pilot, 18 seats).
Ibrahim (SE): logs show NACK from orchestrator: `ERROR orchestrator: onboard complete failed team=ts_99 reason=state_update_timeout`. Possible race in post-auth activation path after last deploy. tagging inc-bot.
inc-bot: INCIDENT INC-2026-910 created, severity=P1, owner=@ibrahim_se. Playbook: onboard-complete-timeout.
June (CS Ops): CS comms plan: 1) Notify CareSense + LumenRx within 30m, 2) Offer manual activation and phone support for trials, 3) Flag CareSense for renewal outreach and consider one-time credit. Rosa can you lead outreach?
Rosa (CSM): I will contact CareSense and LumenRx. Draft message: "We're investigating an activation issue affecting SSO teams. Engineers have a mitigation; we can activate your team manually and schedule a 1:1 onboarding session. ETA initial mitigation <2h. - Rosa, CSM"
Ibrahim (SE): short-term workaround: run `POST /internal/v1/team/force_activate {team_id}` or use admin UI -> Teams -> Force Activate. I'll generate a scoped token for Aiden for 2h.
Aiden (Support): please post curl and scope.
Ibrahim (SE): curl example: `curl -X POST -H 'Authorization: Bearer TEMP-FORCE-2026' https://api.redwood.ai/internal/v1/team/force_activate -d '{"team_id":"<team_id>"}'` token scoped to force_activate, expires in 2h.
Aiden (Support): running force_activate for CareSense now. will confirm when admin accepts invites.
Ibrahim (SE): deploying a canary rollback of recent activation handler change. monitoring for 10m then promote if stable.
inc-bot: Canary deploy started, watch metrics for 10m.
Aiden (Support): CareSense activated and admin accepted invites. LumenRx manual activation accepted on call. WaveHealth activated via API.
Rosa (CSM): outreach sent to CareSense and LumenRx, offered credit + onboarding session to CareSense. Will mark CareSense as at-risk for renewal and add follow-up.
June (CS Ops): status page updated: "Investigating activation stalls for SSO teams; manual activation available; engineers applied rollback canary. Updates every 30m." Posted.
Ibrahim (SE): canary stable, promoted to full rollout. Will own postmortem (INC-2026-910) — initial cause: race in activation ack path introduced in last release. Remediation: add acknowledgement retry + stronger state checks.
inc-bot: INCIDENT INC-2026-910 status -> resolved, resolved_by=@ibrahim_se, resolution_summary="rollback + manual activation".
Rosa (CSM): will run renewal play and log customer sentiment. June, please save comms record and link to incident.
June (CS Ops): comms record saved: https://redwood.internal/cs/records/INC-2026-910. Closing thread after postmortem link posted.
Aiden (Support): collecting timeline logs and will attach to incident. Closing after postmortem is up.
